outcome: hemodynamic parameters (SBP, DBP, MAP, HR, SpO)
cohort: 76 ASA I-II patients aged 18-60 years undergoing elective non-obstetric surgeries under spinal anaesthesia.
finding: Prophylactic intravenous ondansetron significantly reduced the incidence of spinal anaesthesia-induced hypotension, bradycardia, nausea, and vasopressor (mephentermine) requirement, while improving hemodynamic stability compared to placebo.
